0.0: Hello, #h0#.\r\n As you know, Warriors, Magicians, and Bowmen have all been touched by the #bAscension#k. This event allowed us to see just how much you and others like you care about MapleStory.\r\nAs a token of my appreciation, I would like to offer another little event. If you can #breach Level 70 with your newly-created Explorer character#k between #r9/28 - 10/26#k, you will receive #e#b3 types of equipment boxes, based on your level#k#n. Would you like them now?

no.0: Are you sure? This is a great opportunity for free stuff.

yes.0: Here you are. Thank you for your participation, and have an awesome day!
